ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity white central field vs 30% low-intensity black/dark-gray peripheral mapping.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region across the central 80% of both lobes. Low-intensity black bordering along the trailing edges. Discrete dark-gray circular clusters (mottling) scattered in the medial and lower quadrants of the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; vertex angle approximately 55 degrees; depth occupies roughly 18% of the visible vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude variations of 3-10 pixels between peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, terminating in sharp dorsal-ward curls at the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of dark circular spots on the right lobe medial field. Visible 3D textured protrusions (barnacle colonization) localized on the dorsal tips and leading edge margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the inner-medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonies on distal tips and superior edges; dark pigmentary scarring/spots across the white ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Semi-transparent vertical pixel-columns (water runoff) cascading from the trailing edge serrations.
